goal: An AI-authored change should fit an existing Kerf application correctly on its first submitted attempt.

diagnostics.definition: Uses the documented Kerf component or platform primitive that owns the requested concept; does not substitute a merely similar control.
Extends the supplied application-owned data, components, state, and handlers instead of creating parallel replacements.
Uses only exported package subpaths, types, props, custom-element attributes, CSS classes, parts, and tokens.
Connects the new behavior to the existing event flow and retains or invokes every required cleanup/disposer.
Places components in documented legal parent, child, slot, and mutually exclusive prop combinations.
Keeps inset, gap, sizing, overflow, and scrolling on one documented owner at each boundary without private descendant styling.
Provides names, relationships, states, live announcements, and semantic controls required by the frozen case oracle.
All returned TypeScript and TSX compile against the pinned declaration set with no diagnostics.
The frozen user scenario reaches the requested states and repeated mount/unmount leaves no duplicate handlers or stale behavior.
The frozen keyboard scenario completes in logical focus order with visible focus and correct announcements.
At every frozen viewport and 200% zoom, actions remain reachable with no unintended clipping, page overflow, or competing scroll owners.
0 unclear scope; 1 usable with competing emphasis; 2 clear application, page, and section priority.
0 arbitrary or doubled spacing; 1 isolated inconsistencies; 2 one coherent semantic spacing system.
0 clipped or undersized controls; 1 usable but uneven; 2 compact and consistently operable.
0 visibly broken columns or edges; 1 minor drift; 2 shared columns and intentional edges.
0 competing or misplaced scroll regions; 1 usable with an awkward boundary; 2 one obvious scroll owner per pane.

evidenceStages.record: Machine diagnostics over the submitted files and frozen case oracle.
TypeScript diagnostics against pinned package declarations; generated code is not executed.
Recorded assertions from the frozen browser scenario, viewport matrix, and package build.
Named-reviewer 0–2 ratings with viewport screenshots and written rationale.

thresholds.hardGate: Every applicable hard diagnostic passes for a case.
